questions.q: What should you verify before committing to a hosting platform, per the deployment guide?
options: That it has a large user community
That its free tier is genuinely free
That it supports every programming language
That it has the most features
questions.why: The guide advises verifying the tier is genuinely free before committing to a host.

questions.q: Why does the guide recommend adding health checks and logging?
options: So you learn about outages from dashboards, not from users
They are required by most hosts
questions.why: The guide states you should learn about outages from dashboards, not from users.

questions.q: What is one sign you're ready to move past the deployment stage?
options: A stranger can reach the app at a URL
The team has grown to 10 people
questions.why: The guide lists 'a stranger can reach the app at a URL' as a readiness sign for the deployment stage.
